reports.title: CUSA Pro Division Victory at Carlyle Lake, IL goes to Team Mann
reports.text:
“We caught all our fish single poling,” continued Kris. “We were rigged with 1/8 ounce orange/chartreuse Crappie Magnet jigs,” continued Kris. “The bite was slow at times but we battled it out and caught about 25 crappies for the day. Dad (Terry) caught the fish that put us over the edge with about 20 minutes left in the day, proving yet again to never give up!”
“When the start fishing time came we weren’t even ready to drop a line yet. We started spider rigging a very small break line from 7- to 8-feet deep. It had a really small rock pile where we caught our first couple of fish. Then we moved to one other spot and fished another small break from 5- to 7-feet deep. It had a little rock…
